def values(df):
    """Return numpy representation of pandas object.
    
    This ensures extension array dtypes are properly converted to numpy dtypes,
    matching pandas behavior.
    """
    # Get the values from the pandas object
    result = df.values
    
    # For extension array dtypes, pandas converts to numpy arrays with appropriate dtypes
    # We need to ensure the same behavior in dask
    return result
